channel.title: nexusEVnews
channel.description: Independent EV and renewable energy news, curated daily. Electric vehicles, solar, battery tech, and charging infrastructure.

item.title: Slate's $24,950 Electric Truck, Driven
item.dc:creator: Gjeebs
item.description: Slate held its first drive event and held the line on price. A 65 kWh pack, 205 miles, crank windows and no screen, starting at $24,950 with the federal credit gone.

item.title: The Rivian R2 Lidar Debate Misses the Bigger Upgrade
item.dc:creator: Travis Ketchum
item.description: Reservation holders are fixated on a lidar sensor. Travis Ketchum argues the autonomy computer nobody can see is the part that decides how the car ages.

item.title: Jaguar's Gen4 Formula E Car Climbs the Goodwood Hill
item.dc:creator: Formula E
item.description: Fernando Barrichello took Jaguar TCS Racing's Gen4 challenger up the Goodwood hill on Thursday, the first proper public look at the car that reshapes Formula E.

item.title: A $132,000 Macan GTS and the Cost of Every Box Ticked
item.dc:creator: Out of Spec BITS
item.description: Out of Spec walks a 2026 Macan GTS window sticker line by line. Wheels at $3,010, stitching at $3,710, and a headrest crest at $390. The math is the review.

item.title: The Tesla Semi Faces Its First Fatal Crash Investigation
item.dc:creator: Kim Java
item.description: A June 28 crash near Reno is the first fatal incident involving a Tesla Semi. The podcast reports two deaths, a seized truck, and no answers on what was active.

item.title: The ID. Buzz Camper Volkswagen Will Not Sell You
item.dc:creator: The Endless Adventure
item.description: A Seattle shop turns a 2025 ID. Buzz into a full camper with a pop top, induction cooktop and its own power bank. The bus fantasy, minus the breakdowns.

item.title: The Fiat Topolino Goes on Sale in the US for Under $15,000
item.dc:creator: YOUCAR
item.description: Car and Driver reports the tiny Fiat is now on sale at $14,985, with 8 horsepower and 46 miles of range. It cannot legally use a public road until a free kit ships this fall.

item.title: Driving the Rivian R2: The Questions Owners Actually Ask
item.dc:creator: Mike Kantorski
item.description: An R1T and R1S owner drives the performance R2 and answers what buyers keep asking. Great packaging, sharper handling, a flimsy charge port door and laggy steering wheel dials.

item.title: What the UK Can Learn From Europe's Plug-In Solar Head Start
item.dc:creator: Artisan Electrics
item.description: Germany has had it for years, Australia bans it, and the UK is about to legalize it with an 800 watt cap. Artisan Electrics asks four countries what happens after the rules change.

item.title: The Zeekr 7GT Won't Hit 450 kW, and It Hardly Matters
item.dc:creator: Out of Spec Roaming
item.description: Three sessions, two chargers, one 460 amp ceiling. The advertised 450 kW peak never arrived, but 10 to 80 percent came in under 12 minutes against a claimed 13.

item.title: The Flat-Pack Wind Turbine Betting on Vertical Blades
item.dc:creator: Undecided with Matt Ferrell
item.description: A Swedish firm floats a vertical-axis turbine into deep water where fixed towers cannot go. The design cuts maintenance but fights a century of horizontal-axis wins.

item.title: A Five-Year-Old Polestar 2 Still Holds Up, With Caveats
item.dc:creator: Mr. EV
item.description: Google built-in navigation and one-pedal driving age well. The battery-hump rear seat and scratch-prone piano black do not. A used buyer's look.

item.title: Mercedes CLA: Big Range, Familiar Doubts About the Cabin
item.dc:creator: Everything Electric CARS
item.description: The new CLA claims a 484-mile WLTP figure and a European Car of the Year win. The hardware convinces. Whether the cabin feels like a Merc is the open question.

item.title: Tesla's Autobidder Turns a French Coal Site Into a Battery Trader
item.dc:creator: Tesla
item.description: At a former coal plant near Nantes, Tesla's Autobidder software bids Megapack capacity into wholesale and grid-service markets. A look at the trading layer.

item.title: An Electric Boat Runs Flat Out Until It Quits: 25 Miles
item.dc:creator: Out of Spec Reviews
item.description: A Flux Marine-powered Scout goes full throttle from full to empty on one lake. The thermal system holds. The range and charging math is the honest catch.

item.title: Ferrari's EV Sells Out While Dacia Builds Britain's Cheapest Car
item.dc:creator: Electrifying
item.description: Ferrari's first EV sells out its opening China allocation while Dacia cuts the Spring to under 12,000 pounds, plus bargain Fiskers and seven-seat EVs.

item.title: The Self-Driving Story Nobody Is Telling
item.dc:creator: Jacob Hunka
item.description: The autonomy debate is all horse race. But for millions of people who cannot drive, a car that drives itself is the keys, handed back. Why Rivian's road to Level 4 matters more than the spec sheet, and the one thing it still has to get right.

item.title: We Built the Tracker We Wish Existed When We Were Waiting for Our R1s
item.dc:creator: Jacob Hunka
item.description: People were reading website source code to find out when their Rivian was coming. Forum signatures listed Guide contact dates like military service records. We are not doing that again for the R2. The Rivian R2 Delivery Tracker is live.

item.title: Two Batteries, One Hitch, and the Case for All-Electric Glamping
item.dc:creator: Jacob Hunka
item.description: The Lightship AE1 carries its own 69 kWh battery and 80 kW motor to neutralize trailer drag on the tow vehicle. Paired with a Rivian, the real-world efficiency numbers are hard to argue with. This is what all-electric glamping looks like when the hardware actually works.

item.title: Atlanta, Rivian, and the Quiet Coincidence
item.dc:creator: Jacob Hunka
item.description: Atlanta has a failing air quality grade and a Rivian plant on its doorstep. A hypothetical about what one city could do with the electric mobility infrastructure that already exists — R2 autonomous taxis, ALSO cargo quads, e-bikes, and ZTL-style restricted zones — and what the health data says the stakes actually are. Includes data from the HEI lockdown air quality study (Chen et al., 2025) and the American Lung Association's 2025 Atlanta air quality report.
